hero.headline: Chat is the agent now
hero.sub: The native Chat screen is the default for everyone — new installs and existing ones. The embedded terminal is still here, one dropdown away, marked legacy.

shot.alt: The Chat screen: a Claude answer in markdown, an AskUserQuestion tool card, and a native survey card with clickable options and a Submit button
shot.caption: A real session in the app: the answer as prose, the question as a card you click.

items.title: Everyone starts in Chat
items.text: You don't have to find a beta toggle. On the next launch every Claude entry point opens the Chat screen — including for people who never turned it on.

items.title: The terminal became Terminal (legacy)
items.text: Still the full embedded Claude Code TUI, still one setting away. It stops being the thing you land in and becomes the thing you choose.

items.title: Same engine underneath
items.text: Skills, sub-agents, slash commands and the SessionStart brain preload are identical. Only the rendering changed — a chat and a terminal tab resume the same conversation.

blocks.title: One switch, in one place
blocks.body: Settings → Agents → Agent screen. Pick Chat or Terminal (legacy) and that choice takes over every way you start Claude. Sessions already running keep the surface they started on; the choice applies from the next open or resume.

shot.alt: Settings → Agents with the Agent screen dropdown set to Chat (default), above the explanation of the two surfaces

blocks.title: Every entry point follows it
blocks.body: ＋ New, ⌘T, ⌘D side-by-side, reopened tabs, and the sessions Sleep or a delegated task spawn for you — all of them open the screen you picked. Plain shells (⌃`) are unaffected and stay available on both.

shot.alt: The ＋ New menu in the agent overlay offering New chat (⌘T) and New terminal (⌃`)

blocks.text: If you deliberately switch back to Terminal (legacy), it sticks — the one-time move to Chat runs once and never overrides a choice you made yourself.

closer.title: Want the raw surface back?
closer.body: Settings → Agents → Agent screen → Terminal (legacy). Nothing else about your sessions changes; the next tab you open is a terminal again.
